tools.name: agiled_check_connection
tools.description: Return the token's user and workspace scope. Run it first to confirm the API base URL, token and workspace. Agiled API: GET /public/v1/me.

tools.name: agiled_list_contacts
tools.description: List CRM contacts, with filters for email, full name and created or updated dates. Agiled API: GET /public/v1/contacts.

tools.name: agiled_get_contact
tools.description: Return one CRM contact by id. Agiled API: GET /public/v1/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: agiled_list_accounts
tools.description: List CRM accounts (companies), with filters for name and email. Agiled API: GET /public/v1/accounts.

tools.name: agiled_get_account
tools.description: Return one CRM account by id. Agiled API: GET /public/v1/accounts/{id}.

tools.name: agiled_list_deals
tools.description: List CRM deals in the pipeline, with filters for name and status. Agiled API: GET /public/v1/deals.

tools.name: agiled_get_deal
tools.description: Return one CRM deal by id. Agiled API: GET /public/v1/deals/{id}.

tools.name: agiled_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices, with filters for invoice number and status. Agiled API: GET /public/v1/invoices.

tools.name: agiled_get_invoice
tools.description: Return one invoice by id. Agiled API: GET /public/v1/invoices/{id}.

tools.name: agiled_list_estimates
tools.description: List estimates (quotes) and their status. Agiled API: GET /public/v1/estimates.

tools.name: agiled_list_payments
tools.description: List payments recorded against invoices. Agiled API: GET /public/v1/payments.

tools.name: agiled_list_expenses
tools.description: List recorded business expenses. Agiled API: GET /public/v1/expenses.

tools.name: agiled_list_projects
tools.description: List projects, with filters for name and status. Agiled API: GET /public/v1/projects.

tools.name: agiled_get_project
tools.description: Return one project by id. Agiled API: GET /public/v1/projects/{id}.

tools.name: agiled_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks, with filters for title, status and project. Agiled API: GET /public/v1/tasks.

tools.name: agiled_get_task
tools.description: Return one task by id. Agiled API: GET /public/v1/tasks/{id}.

tools.name: agiled_list_time_entries
tools.description: List tracked time entries. Agiled API: GET /public/v1/time-entries.

tools.name: agiled_list_files
tools.description: List file records and their metadata (not the file contents). Agiled API: GET /public/v1/files.

tools.name: agiled_list_users
tools.description: List workspace users, for example to find an assignee id. Agiled API: GET /public/v1/users.

tools.name: agiled_list_webhook_subscriptions
tools.description: List webhook subscriptions and the events they receive. Agiled API: GET /public/v1/webhook-subscriptions.

tools.name: agiled_create_contact
tools.description: Create a CRM contact. Pass an idempotency_key built from the external record id, so a retry does not create a duplicate. Agiled returns HTTP 422 when a field is invalid. Agiled API: POST /public/v1/contacts.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agiled_check_connection, agiled_list_contacts, agiled_list_accounts · Private data: agiled_check_connection, agiled_list_contacts, agiled_get_contact, agiled_list_files, agiled_create_contact · Public sink: agiled_list_contacts, agiled_list_accounts, agiled_list_webhook_subscriptions, agiled_create_contact · Destructive: agiled_check_connection.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agiled_check_connection, agiled_list_contacts, agiled_list_accounts · Private data: agiled_check_connection, agiled_list_contacts, agiled_get_contact, agiled_list_files, agiled_create_contact · Public sink: agiled_list_contacts, agiled_list_accounts, agiled_list_webhook_subscriptions, agiled_create_contact · Destructive: agiled_check_connection

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
